prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: R’Bonney Gabriel of the United States was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning. She won Miss Universe 2022 at age 28.
